Between the parentheses are two separate horizontal strokes on the same level, with a visible gap between them and no letter bodies.

After the barred e, the alleged index merges with the letter's right exit as a short terminal downstroke. No separate dot or complete lower hook remains to distinguish i from j securely.
One baseline e loop is followed at lower right by a thick descender with a hooked lower return and a dot above it. The deep return identifies j despite the retracing.
